description:
Title: New Application for Registering for an USI course

If you want to register for a course at the sports institute, you need to select a course.
If slots are free, the system tells you the courses, and dates.
Select one.
Next, you need to check if you already have an account at the sports institute.
If not, you need to check whether you are registered at an eligible university.
If you are, register your account.
If you are not, request an activation and wait for a response.
As soon as you have an account, log into it.
The application is also connected to your twitter account, and lets you tweet to friends who might want to join you, you can complete the registration for the course and provide the payment information.
In the end, you will receive a course ticket.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_USICourseRegistration"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/usi-course-registration">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AvailableCourses" name="Available courses and dates"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ActivationRequest" name="Activation request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentInformation" name="Payment information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourseTicket" name="Course ticket"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_USICourseRegistration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SportsInstituteSystem" name="Sports institute system" processRef="Process_SportsInstituteSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AvailableCourses" name="Available courses and dates"
                      sourceRef="Task_PresentCourses" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCourses"
                      messageRef="Message_AvailableCourses"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ActivationRequest" name="Activation request"
                      sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_ActivationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendActivationResponse" targetRef="Event_ReceiveActivationResponse"
                      messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentInformation" name="Payment information"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="Event_PaymentInformation"
                      messageRef="Message_PaymentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourseTicket" name="Course ticket"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendCourseTicket" targetRef="Event_ReceiveTicket"
                      messageRef="Message_CourseTicket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Tweet to friends"
                      sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Participant_Twitter"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="New Application for Registering for a USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ApplicantStart" name="Start course registration">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApplicantStart_ReceiveCourses</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveCourses" name="Receive courses and dates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApplicantStart_ReceiveCourses</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveCourses_SelectCourse</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AvailableCourses" messageRef="Message_AvailableCourses"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select a course">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveCourses_SelectCourse</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectCourse_CheckAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check whether you already have an account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectCourse_CheckAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckAccount_AccountGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountExists" name="Already have an account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckAccount_AccountGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountExists_MergeAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAccount_CheckUniversity</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckUniversity" name="Check registration at an eligible university">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAccount_CheckUniversity</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckUniversity_EligibilityGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_UniversityEligible" name="Registered at an eligible university?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckUniversity_EligibilityGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Eligible_RegisterAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotEligible_RequestActivation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register your account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Eligible_RegisterAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterAccount_MergeAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request an activation" messageRef="Message_ActivationRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotEligible_RequestActivation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestActivation_ReceiveResponse</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveActivationResponse" name="Wait for and receive an activation response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestActivation_ReceiveResponse</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ActivationResponse_MergeAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ActivationResponse" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAccountPaths" name="Account available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountExists_MergeAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterAccount_MergeAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ActivationResponse_MergeAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeAccount_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log into your account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeAccount_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TweetAndRegisterSplit" name="Tweet and register">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Tweet</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends who might want to join">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Tweet</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Tweet_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteRegistration_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TweetAndRegisterJoin" name="Continue after tweeting and registration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Tweet_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompleteRegistration_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_ProvidePayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePayment" name="Provide payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_ProvidePayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProvidePayment_ReceiveTicket</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive course ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProvidePayment_ReceiveTicket</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveTicket_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CourseTicket" messageRef="Message_CourseTicket"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ApplicantEnd" name="Course ticket received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveTicket_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicantStart_ReceiveCourses" sourceRef="Event_ApplicantStart" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveCourses_SelectCourse" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveCourses" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectCourse_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_AccountGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists_MergeAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAccountPaths">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">accountExists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount_CheckUniversity" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_CheckUniversity">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not accountExists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckUniversity_EligibilityGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckUniversity" targetRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible_RegisterAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">registeredAtEligibleUniversity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible_RequestActivation" sourceRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not registeredAtEligibleUniversity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterAccount_MergeAccount" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAccountPaths"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestActivation_ReceiveResponse" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActivationResponse_MergeAccount" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAccountPaths"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeAccount_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAccountPaths" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_TweetAndRegisterSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetAndRegisterSplit" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CompleteRegistration" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetAndRegisterSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Gateway_TweetAndRegisterJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteRegistration_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_TweetAndRegisterJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_ProvidePayment" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetAndRegisterJoin" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvidePayment_ReceiveTicket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="Event_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTicket_End" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Event_ApplicantEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SportsInstituteSystem" name="Sports institute system" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_SlotsAvailable" name="Slots are free">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SlotsAvailable_PresentCourses</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_SlotsAvailable">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">slotsAvailable</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PresentCourses" name="Tell the applicant the courses and dates when slots are free">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SlotsAvailable_PresentCourses</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PresentCourses_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_CoursesProvidedEnd" name="Courses and dates provided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PresentCourses_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ActivationRequest" name="Receive activation request">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ActivationRequest_SendResponse</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ActivationRequest" messageRef="Message_ActivationRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendActivationResponse" name="Send activation response" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ActivationRequest_SendResponse</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendActivationResponse_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ActivationResponseEnd" name="Activation response sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendActivationResponse_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_PaymentInformation" name="Receive payment information">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentInformation_SendTicket</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentInformation" messageRef="Message_PaymentInformation"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCourseTicket" name="Send course ticket" messageRef="Message_CourseTicket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentInformation_SendTicket</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendCourseTicket_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_CourseTicketEnd" name="Course ticket sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendCourseTicket_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsAvailable_PresentCourses" sourceRef="Event_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="Task_PresentCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentCourses_End" sourceRef="Task_PresentCourses" targetRef="Event_CoursesProvidedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActivationRequest_SendResponse" sourceRef="Event_ActivationRequest" targetRef="Task_SendActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendActivationResponse_End" sourceRef="Task_SendActivationResponse" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponseEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentInformation_SendTicket" sourceRef="Event_PaymentInformation" targetRef="Task_SendCourseTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendCourseTicket_End" sourceRef="Task_SendCourseTicket" targetRef="Event_CourseTicketEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
